introHtml: Lat Apparel delivers a modern, athletic-inspired look that works equally well for corporate uniforms, trade show giveaways, and employee appreciation programs. Their moisture-wicking fabrics and contemporary cuts make these pieces a favorite among teams that want performance and style. Whether you screen print a logo on a performance polo or embroider a company crest on a quarter-zip pullover, Lat Apparel products hold color and shape through repeated washing.
